post.caption:
London taxi drivers who memorise 25,000 streets have a measurably enlarged hippocampus, and it grows across the years of training rather than before it. Musicians show the same in the motor regions for the fingers they use. The strongest evidence comes from damage: stroke patients reroute function to undamaged regions, and people blind from birth recruit visual cortex for touch and hearing. Adult brains are not fixed. They are just expensive to change.
